A treasury question deserves an answer you can check.
The model never reads raw transactions. It calls typed tools, and the tools do the math.
Thirteen point one four million UNI, sent to the Uniswap Foundation.
Behind that number are two real transactions on Ethereum, and the answer links to both.
Before you see it, a verifier checks every figure against the tool output. Untraceable numbers never reach you.
And it knows when to say no: no investment advice, no private wallets, no guessing past its data.
On eighty-five questions with independent answers, it got eighty-eight point seven percent right. Reading raw data, the same model got six point five.
DAO Treasury Analyst. Numbers you can check. Open source, on GitHub.
